implementation.legacy_behavior: DerivativeSupremumEvidence is caller metadata only. QContractionCertificate.verify_with_evidence always leaves is_certified false; the is_certified field is private and its public accessor always returns false.
implementation.authority_type: VerifiedQContractionCertificate has private fields and can only be created by verify_q_contraction_evidence after replay.
implementation.source_model: PolynomialRhsMap with coefficients interpreted as exact finite binary64 dyadic values, canonical term ordering and immutable model epoch.
implementation.preconditioner: fixed invertible diagonal P; arbitrary PreconditionerAction callbacks have no certification route.
implementation.domain_enclosure: Euclidean ball is contained in outward-rounded coordinate box [x_c_i-r,x_c_i+r].
implementation.derivative_bound: outward interval Jacobian over the entire containing box; Frobenius upper bound dominates induced Euclidean operator 2-norm.
implementation.artifact: versioned schema/algorithm/source SHA/model epoch/norm/center/radius/box/derivative bounds/residual bounds/q/rho/margin; replay compares exact binary64 endpoint bits.
implementation.runtime_binding: PolynomialContractionSource.to_preconditioned_map constructs the runtime map from the same immutable G and P descriptor.
implementation.failure_policy: nonfinite values, overflow, unsupported source, singular P, noncontraction, failed Banach self-map check or resource cap produce Err/refusal.

limitations_and_open_review.exact_real_vs_fp: The theorem applies to the exact real polynomial whose coefficients are the exact dyadic values represented by f64. It does not yet enclose all floating-point evaluation/roundoff effects of the runtime solver.
limitations_and_open_review.replay_independence: Producer and verifier currently share build_q_contraction_evidence. Replay detects source/artifact mismatch, but the algorithm itself is not a separately implemented or formally verified checker.
limitations_and_open_review.consumer_integration: The repository search found the legacy certificate API in rhs_homotopy.rs/tests/lib exports and no solver consumer. Review whether a downstream consumer needs explicit VerifiedQContractionCertificate integration; do not change default solver behavior.
limitations_and_open_review.norm_domain: The certificate uses Euclidean L2 vector norm and its induced operator norm, with a conservative coordinate-box superset of the ball.
limitations_and_open_review.formal_status: No Lean kernel-checked proof is claimed. Recheck local Lean/Mathlib availability before proposing formalization.
